m.**Bydgoszczanie zgodnie z tradycją będą: Bydgoszcz will be able to celebrate the Niepodległości Festival in a sporting way. On Wednesday (11 November) the Bydgoszcz Niepodległości Race and the Niepodległości Bike Rally will take place. We also remind you that Sunday timetables will apply on this day.
m.**Na czas trwania Bydgoskiego Biegu Niep: For the duration of Bydgoszcz's Niepodległości Run on Wednesday (11 November) a temporary organization of traffic on Gdańsk Street will be introduced on the section from the intersection with Czerkaska Street to the junction with Zamczysko Street and the streets adjacent to it (only on this section).
m.**Powrót rowerzystów na bydgoskie drogi: The return of cyclists to Bydgoszcz roads is planned around 5:30 p.m. from Osowa Góra. They will pass Grunwaldzka Street, Kruszwicka Street, via Plac Poznański, Grudziądzka Street, Jagielloński Walami Street, Jan Kazimierza Street. The rally finish is in the Old Market Square. The participants of the rally throughout the route will be exported by the police to ensure the safety of all road users. Temporary difficulties for drivers and public transport passengers may occur during the journey.
m.Jako pierwsi na bydgoskie drogi wyjadą r: The bikers will be the first to leave for the Bydgoszcz roads. The participants of the rally will begin from the Heroes of Bydgoszcz Cemetery at the Liberty Hill around 8:00 p.m.. They will then go through: Biziela Street, Polish Army, Kujawski, Rondo Bernardyńskie, Jagiellońska Street, Fordońska Street, Rejewski Street, Academical Street, Corfantego Street, Twardzicki Street, Boltucia Street to the Valley of Death. After celebrating the memory of the fallen, they will return to the rally route and go to Twardzicki, Korfanty, Pod Skarpa and further along the roads of Osielsko commune.
m.Kurs z pętli Podkowa o godzinie 10:05 zo: The course from the Podkowa loop at 10:05 will be directed to the route temporarily changed from the National Army/Riding Army stop
m.Kursy wydłużone do Podkowy odjeżdżające: Courses extended to Podkowy departing from the Błonie loop at 9:15 and 10:20 will be directed on the route temporarily changed from Sułkowski/Czerkaska stop, Modrzewiowa street, Cardinal Wyszyński avenue and Home Army avenue from the Home Army stop/Zamczysko return to the permanent route.
m.Organizacja imprezy sportowej spowoduje: The organisation of a sporting event will also result in changes in the functioning of public transport. Buses of line 52, 93, 94 and ZaT from around 9:30 to around 11:15 will take the changed route.
m.Z uwagi na bezpieczeństwo prosimy o bezw: For reasons of safety, we ask you to comply strictly with the temporary marking and the orders of the law enforcement services to regulate traffic within the streets covered by the temporary organisation of traffic.
m.Zamknięcie ul. Gdańskiej dla ruchu nastą: The closure of Gdańska Street for traffic will take place from 09:30. This means that the crossing of Gdańska Street towards the city from the side of Osielsko commune will be possible only until the intersection with Zamczysko Street, while in the opposite direction only until the intersection with Czerkaska Street. The entrance to Gdańsk Street from Modrzewiowa Street, 11 November and Recreational Street from 09:30 will be impossible. Directions to the city and departure in the northern direction should be planned by the Home Army street. Difficulties will last until approximately 11 p.m.
